scope: Bibliography extraction, source linkage, canonical-URL preservation and reading-route identifier checks; not a proof audit or live availability test.

checks.name: All 1,065 source UIDs represented exactly once
Every source/family/route identifier resolves in retained atlas
Every exact URL belongs to its conservatively canonicalized record
All annual reference lists and six Hamiltonian context records included
External references are linked, not redistributed
All relative Markdown file targets exist in the repository

count_reconciliation.explanation: tables/references.csv contains 997 developed treatment citation-use rows. These differ from unique URLs/documents, and this bibliography also includes original historical references, family references, annual lists and Hamiltonian context. source_uid_count deduplicates each treatment within each document.
